Proven track record of translating complex business requirements into data-driven solutions, bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams, and delivering automation initiatives that generate measurable efficiency gains.

Experienced in partnering with Trading, Operations, Risk, Technology, Compliance and regional stakeholders to deliver regulatory and control solutions with minimal business impact, including CASS, CSDR, SFTR, EMIR, MIFID, CFTC and Dodd-Frank regulatory requirements.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst – Senior Associate | Goldman Sachs Jan 2024 – Jun 2026 | Bengaluru, India
Defined and implemented business requirements for client valuation reporting across EQD, FX, IRD, CDS,
CMDS, and Bonds on Bloomberg, Reuters, and Telekurs, supporting 100+ institutional clients. • Automated trade confirmation tracking using SQL and VBA, eliminating manual processing and
delivering a 0.44 FTE reduction in operational effort.
Designed and maintained valuation report frameworks in VBA/SQL aligned to client and sales
specifications, reducing report turnaround time and improving data accuracy.
Led end-to-end implementation of corporate action new workflow automation. • Drove compliance and data quality for SFTR, EMIR, MIFID, CFTC, and Dodd-Frank trade valuations, ensuring 100% timely FIA TECH portal submissions within regulatory deadlines.
Spearheaded EMEA Client Services migration from Lisbon, coordinating cross-regional handover with
zero client-impacting incidents.
Supported Regulatory Assurance activities for securities and derivatives reporting processes by validating regulatory data, assessing reporting completeness and accuracy, identifying control exceptions and coordinating remediation with Operations, Risk and Compliance teams.
Performed Regulatory Impact Assessments for changes to MiFID, SFTR, EMIR and other applicable
regulatory requirements, analysing impacts across business processes, reporting data, systems, controls and downstream reporting obligations.
Supported Regulatory Change Management initiatives by translating regulatory requirements into
business/process changes, documenting requirements, coordinating with Technology and Operations teams, and validating implementation through UAT.
Performed control framework reviews and data-quality controls across regulatory reporting processes, including validation of source data, reporting fields, regulatory classifications and submission outputs. Investigated regulatory reporting exceptions and data discrepancies through root-cause analysis, identified control/process gaps and supported corrective and preventive actions.

Supported CSDR-related regulatory requirements and securities settlement controls, including assessment of settlement-related process impacts, data validation, exception management and coordination of required process/control changes.
Supported CASS/client asset-related control activities through validation of securities positions,
reconciliation of asset data and review of process controls designed to maintain accuracy and integrity of client asset information.
Worked with Business, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Technology stakeholders to ensure regulatory changes were incorporated into operating procedures, reporting processes and control environments with minimal business disruption.
Delivered the ELIXIR project integrating Exane accounts post-merger into BNP's core valuation system, and contributed as a key resource to the Bridge initiative to resolve daily trading report technical limitations.
Analyzed existing business workflows (As-Is) and designed improved, more efficient processes (To-Be). • Created business requirement documents (BRDs), user stories, use cases, and presentations. • Facilitated daily standups and stakeholder meetings to surface blockers, align priorities, and drive continuous improvement.
Supported UAT by creating test cases and acceptance criteria, applying QA / Testing Fundamentals
including functional testing, positive/negative testing, data validation, defect identification, retesting, and regression-impact assessment to ensure new solutions solved the original problem.
Vignesh Babu V | Page 2
Business Analyst – Assistant Manager | BNP Paribas Apr 2021 – Oct 2023 | Chennai, India
Built VBA-driven reporting tools to identify and escalate high-value rejected transactions, reducing
manual investigation time by streamlining root-cause analysis.
Developed SQL queries to detect deposit breaches against Broker-Dealer agreed limits, enabling
proactive risk management.
Maintained team dashboards and MIS reports to track exception volumes, aging, and resolution status
for management review.
Automated recurring reporting processes using Excel VBA, improving team throughput and reducing
manual effort.
Coordinated with Broker-Dealers to resolve documentation exceptions and facilitate timely approvals
for Federal and State tax withholding instructions.
Supported Client Asset and Asset Protection controls by validating transaction, cash and securities- related data and ensuring discrepancies impacting client positions were identified, investigated and resolved within defined control timelines.
Performed reconciliation and validation checks across internal records and external/broker data to
maintain the accuracy, completeness and integrity of client asset positions.
Supported CASS and CSDR compliance activities by reviewing applicable operational requirements,
identifying process/control impacts and ensuring relevant procedures and controls were aligned with regulatory expectations.
Performed control assessments and risk reviews across operational processes, identifying control gaps,
documenting exceptions and supporting remediation actions.
Conducted Regulatory Impact Assessments for changes affecting securities operations, transaction processing and reporting, working with Business, Risk, Compliance and Technology stakeholders to determine required process changes.
Supported Regulatory Change Management through requirement analysis, impact assessment, process

documentation, UAT and implementation of revised controls and procedures. Investigated operational exceptions and performed root-cause analysis to identify recurring control weaknesses and implement preventive measures.
Senior Analyst | Goldman Sachs Aug 2017 – Apr 2021 | Bengaluru, India
Processed and reconciled brokerage payments to distributors under upfront and trail commission
models, ensuring accuracy across high-volume transaction cycles.
Collaborated with project management, technology, legal, compliance, and internal audit teams to drive
system changes and process automation initiatives.
Handled end-to-end distributor payment activities including Incentives, Marketing Payments, and
Additional Payments, resolving commission queries and escalations.
Generated ad-hoc management reports by coordinating with fund accounting and corporate accounting
teams to claim and validate funding details.
Supported Custody Operations and Client Asset processes, including reconciliation and validation of
securities/cash positions, transaction records and asset-related data.
Performed control checks to ensure client asset records were complete, accurate and appropriately

reconciled against relevant internal and external records. Investigated breaks and discrepancies affecting client asset positions, performed root-cause analysis and coordinated resolution with Operations, Accounting, Custody and other stakeholders.
Supported asset protection and safeguarding controls through reconciliation, exception monitoring, data
validation and escalation of material discrepancies.
• Supported CASS and CSDR-related operational requirements, including review of applicable controls, reconciliation processes, settlement-related requirements and remediation of identified process gaps.
Vignesh Babu V | Page 3

control execution and supporting audit and compliance requirements.
Participated in regulatory change initiatives, assessing operational impact and supporting updates to

Associate | RR Donnelley Jun 2016 – Jul 2017 | Chennai, India
Executed treasury reconciliations for deposits and loans; processed rejected entries and generated
Certificates of Interest (COI) for multi-country tax reporting.
Produced client statements and status enquiries assessing financial commitments, supporting the client
servicing team with accurate, audit-ready outputs.
Coordinated central team operations for issuing cheque books, credit/debit cards, and passcodes
following multi-step client verification processes.
raw_sections.projects:
KEY PROJECTS
Led migration of EMEA OTC Derivatives Client Services from Lisbon to Chennai with zero service
disruption.
Automated various trade capturing and reporting processes, achieving 1.8 FTE savings. • Delivered static setup for Exane accounts merged into post-acquisition. • Key contributor to redesigning the corporate action end-to-end notification process. • Resolved existing technical limitations in daily trading report generation.
REGULATORY ASSURANCE & SECURITIES SERVICES EXPERIENCE • Custody Operations: Experience supporting securities/custody operations through cash and securities reconciliation, position validation, settlement processing, exception investigation and reconciliation against external/broker/custodian records.
Client Assets & Asset Protection: Experience performing controls and validation activities to maintain the accuracy, completeness and integrity of client asset positions, identifying discrepancies and supporting timely remediation and escalation.
CASS: Experience supporting CASS requirements through client asset-related reconciliation, safeguarding
controls, operational control checks, exception management and compliance assessments.
CSDR: Experience supporting CSDR requirements through assessment of settlement-related obligations, operational/process impact analysis, control reviews, data validation and implementation of required process changes.
Regulatory Assurance: Experience conducting regulatory compliance checks, control reviews,
independent validation, exception analysis, risk assessments and remediation of process/control weaknesses.
Control Frameworks: Experience reviewing and strengthening operational control frameworks through control validation, reconciliation controls, data-quality checks, threshold validation, preventive controls and governance reporting.
Regulatory Change Management: Experience analysing regulatory changes, translating requirements into
business/process changes, coordinating implementation with Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance teams, and supporting UAT and implementation validation.
Regulatory Impact Assessment: Experience assessing regulatory changes for their impact on business
processes, reporting obligations, data, systems, controls and operational risk, followed by implementation of appropriate process and control enhancements.
Governance & Audit: Experience preparing regulatory/control documentation, exception analysis, MI and
evidence to support governance reviews, audits and regulatory compliance assessments.
Vignesh Babu V | Page 4
